scope: Eight-model code-behavior comparison on previously published cases. Complete first pass plus separately recorded retries of HTTP failures only. No valid response replaced.

metric_notes.accuracy: Primary quality uses original valid response, otherwise ordered retry. Failures count wrong.
metric_notes.latency: First-pass valid responses only; excludes failed requests and all retries.
metric_notes.cost: Known provider usage only; failed-attempt cost is unavailable. Per1000completedcase cost excludes unknown failure charges.
metric_notes.retries: One318-call pass with3secondspacing, then one explicitly authorized third attempt. No answer-based retries.
